name: Jehoiada
summary: The priest who hid young Joash in the LORD's house and then made him king of Judah. While Jehoiada lived, he taught the king and led the people to belong to the LORD.

key_moments.title: Crowns the Hidden Prince Joash
key_moments.description: In year seven, Jehoiada gathered the captains in the LORD's house, made them swear an oath, and showed them the hidden prince. With guards all around, they crowned Joash and cheered for their new king.

key_moments.title: Leads a Covenant with the LORD
key_moments.description: Jehoiada led king and people in a covenant to belong to the LORD. The people then tore down Baal's temple and smashed its altars and images.

key_moments.title: Sets Up a Chest for the Temple Money
key_moments.description: Jehoiada drilled a hole in a chest's lid and placed it next to the altar. The money the people brought was put in it and used to repair the LORD's house.

key_moments.title: Buried Among the Kings
key_moments.description: Jehoiada lived to be one hundred and thirty. Because of the good he had done in Israel for God, he was buried with the kings in the city of David.
